## Visual evidence — required

<!--
This section is mandatory.

For UI, UX, responsive, browser, camera, upload, navigation, or any other user-visible change:

1. Show representative screenshots or GIFs directly in the PR body or in the automated visual-evidence comment.
2. Show critical flows as directly visible GIFs. A direct video link may be added as a secondary full-length recording.
3. Cover every changed screen and each relevant loading, empty, error, success, offline, permission, focus, and responsive state.
4. Ensure every visual was generated from the current final head SHA.
5. Use temporary GitHub release assets generated by the visual-evidence workflow. Do not commit generated media to the repository.

ZIP files, artifact-download links, artifact IDs, run IDs, local paths, temporary signed URLs, and links that require downloading a bundle do not count as review evidence.

An internal Actions artifact may be used only to transfer files between jobs. Reviewers must never need to download or extract it.

For changes with no user-visible behavior, write "Not applicable" and explain why.

## Delivery checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are covered by tests.
- [ ] Strict type checking, lint, tests, build, security, and relevant architecture checks pass.
- [ ] Migrations are incremental, tested from an empty database and a realistic upgrade path, and include rollback/recovery instructions.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private data, debug output, or unrelated changes are included.
- [ ] User-visible changes show screenshots directly in the PR.
- [ ] Critical user flows show GIFs directly in the PR; optional full videos use direct links.
- [ ] Visual evidence belongs to the final head SHA.
- [ ] No ZIP or downloadable artifact bundle is presented as review evidence.
- [ ] Generated media is temporary and is not committed to the repository.
- [ ] Documentation and the task specification are updated.
- [ ] Merge, release, deployment, publication, and remote migrations were not performed without explicit approval.
